_meta.description: Per-fuel-type tranche definitions with heat-rate multipliers. Covers coal (PRB/lignite/bituminous), gas-CC, gas-CT. Each fuel has tranches: must-run/committed/economic (with sigmoid for coal)/peaking.

tranches.name: Must-Run (Take-or-Pay)
tranches.description: Contracted fuel (sunk cost). Bids VOM + carbon only, no fuel cost.

tranches.name: Committed (Spot - Low Gas)
tranches.description: Spot coal when gas is cheap. Sigmoid blends 35% fuel cost (low gas) to 100% (high gas).

tranches.name: Economic (Spot - Full)
tranches.description: Economic dispatch at full fuel cost.

tranches.name: Committed (Minimum Load)
tranches.description: Part-load range when online. Carries startup cost, min-run/min-down window.

tranches.name: Economic Ramp (6 steps)
tranches.description: Rising cost curve. Heat-rate ramp from econ_low to econ_high (6 equal-capacity steps, linear interpolation).

tranches.name: Peaking (Duct Firing)
tranches.description: Duct-fired (F-class turbine ~2.25x). Separate flat tranche above econ ramp. Scarcity pricing.

gas_cc.notes: Each CC plant dispatches on its own measured heat rate; multipliers are per-plant anchored.

example_coal_passthrough_trace.description: PRB sigmoid: as gas price rises, coal spot (economic) tranche moves from 85% fuel cost passthrough to 100%.
